steps.name: first frame
steps.assert: (() => { const g = window.__falesc; if (!g || !g.ready || g.snapshot().frame < 1) return false; const gl = g.app.app.renderer.gl; return !gl || !gl.isContextLost || !gl.isContextLost(); })()
steps.message: Pixi should render a first frame without a lost WebGL context

steps.name: set deterministic seed
steps.eval: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lobby-seed]'); input.value = '12345'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return input.value; })()

steps.name: world contents
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); return s.seed === 12345 && s.characters === 15 && s.minerals > 0 && s.actionsRemaining === 1 && s.lumen === 8 && s.dayLimit === 14 && s.selectedBlueprint === 'prism_rig'; })()
steps.message: expected seeded world with 15 characters, minerals, one build action, and the starting economy

steps.name: hover a free plot
steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.__falesc.app; const cell = window.__falesc.findFreeCell(); const p = window.__falesc.worldToScreen(cell.x, cell.y); const canvas = document.querySelector('body > canvas'); canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, pointerType: 'mouse', pointerId: 9 })); window.__hoverWasVisible = g.hoverGhost.visible; canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerleave', { bubbles: true, pointerType: 'mouse', pointerId: 9 })); return { shown: window.__hoverWasVisible, cleared: g.hoverCellKey === null }; })()

steps.name: hover preview shown and cleared
steps.message: expected a ghost preview while hovering a free plot and a cleared highlight after leaving

steps.name: open build modal on a free cell
steps.eval: (() => { const cell = window.__falesc.findFreeCell(); window.__falesc.app.onWorldTap(cell.x, cell.y); return cell; })()

steps.name: building is pending
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); return s.buildings === 1 && s.buildingStates[0] === 'PENDING' && s.actionsRemaining === 0 && s.lumen === 5; })()
steps.message: expected one PENDING building, no actions left, and the blueprint cost paid

steps.name: turn 2 and ghost building
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); return s.state === 'PLAYING' && s.turn === 2 && s.buildingStates[0] === 'RESERVED'; })()
steps.message: expected turn 2 in PLAYING with a RESERVED building

steps.name: turn 3 and active building
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); return s.state === 'PLAYING' && s.turn === 3 && s.buildingStates[0] === 'ACTIVE' && s.income === 2; })()
steps.message: expected turn 3 in PLAYING with an ACTIVE Prism Rig producing income

steps.name: zoom out to map overview
steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.__falesc; g.app.camera.zoom = g.app.camera.minZoom; g.app.camera.position.x = g.app.MAP_WIDTH / 2; g.app.camera.position.y = g.app.MAP_HEIGHT / 2; g.app.camera.updateTransform(); return { zoom: g.app.camera.zoom }; })()

steps.name: restore camera
steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.__falesc; g.app.camera.zoom = 1; g.app.camera.position.x = g.app.MAP_WIDTH / 2; g.app.camera.position.y = g.app.MAP_HEIGHT / 2; g.app.camera.updateTransform(); return true; })()

steps.name: open build modal again
steps.eval: (() => { const cell = window.__falesc.findFreeCell(); window.__falesc.app.onWorldTap(cell.x, cell.y); return cell; })()

steps.name: modal is closed after ending
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); return s.state === 'END' && s.buildModalOpen === false; })()
steps.message: ending the game must dismiss an open build prompt
